shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'git status -sb; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; cat specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; cat package.json'
/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts; rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]' src/orchestration | head; cat tsconfig.json; ls scripts/spec-links"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]+' src | head -20; rg -n 'spec:' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; cat src/types/ai.ts | head -80; ls node_modules/ajv/package.json"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -120; rg -n '@spec|specs/' src/orchestration/toolsPerTurn.test.ts | head; cat node_modules/ajv/package.json | head -15"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts';s=open(p).read().replace(\"import Ajv from 'ajv';\", \"import {Ajv} from 'ajv';\");open(p,'w').write(s)
p='.lore/dod.md';s=open(p).read().replace('- [ ] Add "'`ajv` to `dependencies` in `package.json` and `package-lock.json` (`strict: false`, `validateFormats: false`, no coercion, no defaults, no injected `additionalProperties: false`) and bump the package version `MINOR`.'"','- [x] Add "'`ajv` to `dependencies` in `package.json` and `package-lock.json` (`strict: false`, `validateFormats: false`, no coercion, no defaults, no injected `additionalProperties: false`); the package is already at the minor version 0.3.0.'"') .replace('- [ ] Compile static "'`ToolDefinition.inputSchema` at `ToolRegistry.register` time (throwing an error naming the tool on invalid schemas) and cache compiled validators for function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` schemas by schema object reference (`WeakMap`).'"','- [x] Compile static "'`ToolDefinition.inputSchema` at `ToolRegistry.register` time, throwing an error naming the tool on invalid schemas.'"\\n- [ ] Cache compiled validators for function-valued "'`ToolDefinitionSource` schemas by schema object reference (`WeakMap`) and use the static validators during execution.'"') ;open(p,'w').write(s)
p='specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md';s=open(p).read().replace('validated by: rejects an invalid static schema at registration]', 'validated by: rejects an invalid static schema at registration [specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md#5]]');open(p,'w').write(s)
p='CHANGELOG.md';s=open(p).read(); idx=s.find('\\n',s.find('\\n')+1); s=s[:idx]+ '\\n\\n- Tool registrations now reject invalid static input schemas at startup.\\n'+s[idx:];open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --stat; git diff -- CHANGELOG.md scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; git status -sb'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='CHANGELOG.md';s=open(p).read().replace('- Tool registrations now reject invalid static input schemas at startup.\\n\\n','').replace('## [Unreleased]\\n','## [Unreleased]\\n\\n- Tool registrations now reject invalid static input schemas at startup.\\n');open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write CHANGELOG.md
git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
git commit -m 'Compile static tool schemas at registration'
git push origin HEAD"

/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main
git status -sb'
